title: Heavenly Light Tunisian Phyllo Dough Skillet
description: A light and earthy Tunisian dish featuring layers of flaky phyllo dough and a rich egg and spice mixture, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Thaw 6-8 sheets of phyllo dough according to package instructions.
Cut the remaining phyllo dough into large squares and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, cheddar cheese, parsley, cilantro, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the inside of a 10-inch cast-iron skillet with coconut oil.
Layer 2-3 sheets of phyllo dough in the skillet, brushing each sheet with coconut oil and folding the edges to create a crust.
Pour the egg mixture over the phyllo dough and top with the remaining phyllo dough squares, brushing with coconut oil.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with feta cheese crumbles.
Return to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving with lemon wedges.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley and cilantro if desired.
